name: DMCA
description: Many people are aware of DMCA – Digital Millennium Copyright Act. But another recently proposed DMCA – Digital Millennium Calculation Act – is much less known. In this problem you need to find a root of a number according to this new DMCA law.
input_specification: The input contains a single integer $$$a$$$ ($$$1 \le a \le 1000000$$$).
output_specification: Output the result – an integer number.
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
